BIOLOGY — MOCK EXAM #10
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: BIOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Nitrogen gas only

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Gaseous Exchange and Respiration 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Animals 3.1 Nutri? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Gaseous Exchange and Respiration 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Animals 3.1 Nutri.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Gaseous Exchange and Respiration 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Animals 3.1 Nutri.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Gaseous Exchange and Respiration 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Animals 3.1 Nutri.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Gaseous Exchange and Respiration 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Animals 3.1 Nutri.

3. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Heating until a solid melts

4. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 0 °C

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cell Structure and Specialisation? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cell Structure and Specialisation.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Cell Structure and Specialisation.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cell Structure and Specialisation.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cell Structure and Specialisation.

6. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Removing all vegetation

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Biology 1.2 Specimen Collection and Preservation 1.3 Cell Struct? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to Biology 1.2 Specimen Collection and Preservation 1.3 Cell Struct.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Biology 1.2 Specimen Collection and Preservation 1.3 Cell Struct.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to Biology 1.2 Specimen Collection and Preservation 1.3 Cell Struct.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Biology 1.2 Specimen Collection and Preservation 1.3 Cell Struct.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Gaseous Exchange and Respiration? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Gaseous Exchange and Respiration.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Gaseous Exchange and Respiration.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Gaseous Exchange and Respiration.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Gaseous Exchange and Respiration.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Transport? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Transport.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Transport.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Transport.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Transport.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Nutrition 2.2 Transport 2.3 Gaseous Exchange and Respiration 3.0 Anatomy and Phy? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Nutrition 2.2 Transport 2.3 Gaseous Exchange and Respiration 3.0 Anatomy and Phy.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Nutrition 2.2 Transport 2.3 Gaseous Exchange and Respiration 3.0 Anatomy and Phy.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Nutrition 2.2 Transport 2.3 Gaseous Exchange and Respiration 3.0 Anatomy and Phy.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Nutrition 2.2 Transport 2.3 Gaseous Exchange and Respiration 3.0 Anatomy and Phy.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Specimen Collection and Preservation? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Specimen Collection and Preservation.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Specimen Collection and Preservation.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Specimen Collection and Preservation.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Specimen Collection and Preservation.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Chemicals of Life? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Chemicals of Life.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Chemicals of Life.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Chemicals of Life.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Chemicals of Life.

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Chemicals of life 2.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Plants 2.1 Nutrition 2.2 Transpo? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Chemicals of life 2.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Plants 2.1 Nutrition 2.2 Transpo.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Chemicals of life 2.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Plants 2.1 Nutrition 2.2 Transpo.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Chemicals of life 2.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Plants 2.1 Nutrition 2.2 Transpo.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Chemicals of life 2.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Plants 2.1 Nutrition 2.2 Transpo.

14. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cell Structure and Specialisation 1.4 Chemicals of life 2.0 Anatomy and Physiolo? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Cell Structure and Specialisation 1.4 Chemicals of life 2.0 Anatomy and Physiolo.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cell Structure and Specialisation 1.4 Chemicals of life 2.0 Anatomy and Physiolo.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cell Structure and Specialisation 1.4 Chemicals of life 2.0 Anatomy and Physiolo.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cell Structure and Specialisation 1.4 Chemicals of life 2.0 Anatomy and Physiolo.

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Biology? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to Biology.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to Biology.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Biology.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Biology.

17. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

18. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Nutrition? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Nutrition.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Nutrition.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Nutrition.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Nutrition.

19. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

20. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. watt (W)
   C. joule (J)
   D. newton (N)

21. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Milk souring

22. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Producers
